records.text: Viewer handle Ali reported that Tucker Carlson said he was impressed by Erika Kirk’s fearlessness and intensity when he first met her; this is the viewer’s secondhand report, and Owens said she had not seen the clip.

appearances.snippet: Lastly. Ali writes, love Tucker Carlson, you're referring to. I disagree with him regarding Erika (Erika Kirk). I did not see this clip of Charlie (Charlie Kirk), I mean of Tucker (Tucker Carlson), but what you cite here is that he says when he first met her.
